div.div:
Notation
folder = package (app folder); box = module (file or class); italic = route or role
page with corner = generated file
dashed open arrow = «uses» dependency (import; unlabelled ones too)
«provides» = the provider supplies that React context
Omitted: my-books.tsx also uses api-result.ts; pages also import types from schema.d.ts.
